thread:
maria: Heads-up: found ~1.2k snapshot objects in prod without SSE headers under bucket redwood-db-snapshots prefix snapshots/2026-04-01/
security-bot: [alert] object-store:put-no-sse detected for snapshots/2026-04-01/ - alert id AS-2026-422
aj: Can someone paste one HEAD output? we need to confirm header was never set.
maria: sample HEAD:
```
Content-Length: 536870912
x-amz-meta-origin: backup-service
x-amz-server-side-encryption: <absent>
```
luca: we shipped a refactor to uploader metadata flow last night (PR #5120). Could be a race where SSE injection ran after multipart complete.
aj: CloudTrail shows PutObject by role arn:aws:iam::0123456789:role/svc-uploader-role between 02:05-02:25Z. No kms:GrantTokens present in those calls.
erin: Compliance: any exposure window where objects were accessible unencrypted? need timeline asap.
sam-oncall: Immediate mitigation options: 1) revoke PutObject for svc-uploader-role on that prefix; 2) apply bucket policy deny when s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption != aws:kms. I can apply a temporary deny to snapshots/2026-04-01/* now.
luca: bucket-policy snippet (deny PutObject when SSE != aws:kms):
```
{
  "Sid": "DenyUnencryptedUploads",
  "Effect": "Deny",
  "Principal": "*",
  "Action": "s3:PutObject",
  "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::redwood-db-snapshots/snapshots/2026-04-01/*",
  "Condition": {
    "StringNotEquals": {"s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption": "aws:kms"}
  }
}
```
Use cautiously - will break any non-SSE writers.
aj: I'll extract affected keys and tenant mapping and upload CSV to the incident doc.
maria: Re-encryption approach: copy objects with --metadata-directive REPLACE and --sse aws:kms. For multipart objects, use multipart-copy so ETag/part checksums handled. Validate checksums after.
luca: hotfix: revert metadata refactor to ensure SSE header is set before multipart complete and add integration test. Pushing branch now.
erin: I'll draft notification guidance for customers and legal; wait for CSV to decide who must be notified.
security-bot: Incident INC-2026-422 created. responders: @maria @aj @luca @sam-oncall @erin
sam-oncall: Applied deny policy to the specific prefix at 03:12Z and revoked PutObject for svc-uploader-role as a precaution. Monitoring for failures.
aj: CSV uploaded to incident page + s3 manifest. Starting checksum validation on a 10-object sample.
maria: Good. After patch we should add a CloudTrail Athena alert for PutObject where x-amz-server-side-encryption is null and fail-fast in CI for uploader.
luca: Canary deploy of hotfix to staging in 10m. If green I'll roll to prod and start re-encrypt job for confirmed keys.
erin: Noted. I'll sync with CS for any customers with active restores.
maria: Thanks team. Keep this thread for coordination and paste any blocking errors here. :thumbsup:
